scale.script: export var scriptProperties = createScriptProperties().addSlider({name:'frequency',value:0,min:0,max:15,integer:true}).addSlider({name:'smoothing',value:60,min:0,max:60}).addSlider({name:'minvalue',value:0,min:0,max:1}).addSlider({name:'maxvalue',value:1,min:0,max:1}).finish(); const audioBuffer = engine.registerAudioBuffers(engine.AUDIO_RESOLUTION_16); let initialValue; export function init(value) { initialValue = value; return value; } export function update(value) { const smoothValue = audioBuffer.average[scriptProperties.frequency]; return initialValue.multiply(smoothValue * (scriptProperties.maxvalue - scriptProperties.minvalue) + scriptProperties.minvalue); }
